# SchemeSync AI

> AI-powered platform helping Indian citizens discover, verify eligibility for, and apply to government welfare schemes. One profile, every benefit.

SchemeSync AI is a discovery and application-preparation platform for Indian government welfare schemes. Citizens create a single profile, upload their documents (verified via Gemini Vision OCR), and receive AI-ranked eligibility matches across central and state schemes.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview, features, how it works
- [Sign in](/auth): Google and email authentication

## Optional

- [Schemes catalog](/schemes): 20+ central schemes indexed (PM-KISAN, Ayushman Bharat, PMAY, PMJDY, Ujjwala, MUDRA, and more)
